name: Maternity Action advice line
whoFor: Pregnant women and new parents with questions about rights at work, maternity pay or benefits.
eligibility: Pregnant, on maternity leave or a new parent
Has a question about rights at work, maternity pay or benefits
referralRoutes: Online advice form (Monday to Friday): ask for email advice or a call back

selfReferral.note: Fill in the online form (Monday to Friday) and choose email advice or a call back. You can ask for an interpreter on the form.

projects.name: Maternity Action advice line
projects.overview: Free legal advice on maternity rights at work, maternity pay, benefits, redundancy, pregnancy discrimination and returning to work. They aim to reply within 5 to 10 working days.

coachNotes: If the form says they've reached their limit for the day, try again the next day. They don't advise on childcare costs.
